dialogues.speaker: Yundan
dialogues.text: Just an ordinary old granny. I actually went to Liyue Harbor once, lived the rat race for a while... In the end I realized I'm just a normal person who needs a normal life. So I came back here.

dialogues.speaker: Yundan
dialogues.text: I help look after the little ones in the village. It helps me worry less knowing they are taught to be obedient and well-behaved.

dialogues.speaker: Yundan
dialogues.text: When I was little I would go fishing with my younger brother near Liyue Harbor. We managed to make a bit of money off it, and life started getting better.

dialogues.speaker: Yundan
dialogues.text: But I just couldn't get used to the constant chaos of city life, nor did the cunning one needs to try and do business come naturally to me... Maybe I just wasn't meant to get rich.

dialogues.speaker: Yundan
dialogues.text: I'm much more comfortable here. I positively relish the peace and quiet.
